description: CR 702.179d each active teammate's speed rises once
note: Under shared team turns alice and bob are both active players (CR 805.4), so one opponent's life loss raises both their speeds: each spends their OWN once-each-turn limit (Engine.limitKey's controller component keeps them apart). Alice starts at speed 1 and bob at 2, so a rise is visible on each and a single shared limit would leave one of them behind. The control drops the option and only alice's rises.
